prompt: Create an original 60 second ambient electronic instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: analog pads, granular synth, soft sub bass. Style: slow evolving textures without drums or a beat. Tempo approximately 64 BPM; C major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A majestic and expansive orchestral electronic track featuring soaring synth pads, a driving beat, and a rich, evolving harmonic structure. It builds from a serene opening to a powerful, uplifting climax.
description.zh: 一首宏伟而广阔的管弦电子乐曲，以 soaring 合成器铺垫、强劲的节拍和丰富、不断发展的和声结构为特色。它从宁静的开场逐渐发展到强大、振奋的高潮。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
